counterfactual_missing_items: histopathological confirmation of lymphatic endothelial lining
description of chylous or lymphatic fluid content
explicit exclusion of other retroperitoneal cystic neoplasms
decisive_items: a large retroperitoneal cyst posterior to the right colon, mesocolon, and terminal ileum
a conglomeration of grossly dilated lymphatics near its upper pole was also removed
a large, well-defined, unilocular cyst measuring 20 × 14 × 23 cm located behind the right colon and terminal ileum
response.rationale: R4 uniquely combines the retroperitoneal location and the dilated lymphatics, matching both the surgical anatomy and the lymphatic origin. R1 captures the lymphatic pathology but omits the retroperitoneal location; R3 and C1 capture only the retroperitoneal cyst; R5 is contradicted by the retroperitoneal surgical finding; R2 is less specific than lymphangioma and also omits the retroperitoneal location.

rejected.why: Describes only the retroperitoneal cyst without the lymphatic pathology that explains the dilated lymphatics.
Mesenteric location is contradicted by the operative finding of a retroperitoneal cyst posterior to the right colon and terminal ileum.
Only adds unilocular to R3 and still misses the key lymphatic origin.
Identifies lymphatic origin but lacks the retroperitoneal location and is less diagnostically specific than lymphangioma.
